title: Design: the Vendor menu matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has more than 8 vendors (the Vendor menu shows its search box only when there are more than 8 vendors).
    For example: the QA organization (437 vendors).
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Inventory Value (Reports, then "Inventory Value" under PARTS in the left menu) is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • The design picture "The native Vendor menu" (ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Vendor chip.
  2. Compare the order of the vendors with Inventory Value's Vendor menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens, as in the picture: while the menu is open the chip ("Vendor: All vendors", truck icon) has a light-grey background; the menu opens under it; its rows read, top to bottom, a search box with a magnifier and the placeholder "Search vendors", "All vendors" (ticked), a dividing line, the grey line "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors (the picture's placeholder reads "Search vendor"; the PRD's "Search vendors" is right: see References from Design); each vendor box shows a grey dash while "All vendors" is ticked.
  • Step 2: the same order as Inventory Value's Vendor menu.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png: figure "The native Vendor menu" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"

The design's own words:

  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")

Difference from the PRD (DD-02), closed: PRD version 5 said Vendor "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors")" (S5-R13); the design shows the Vendor menu's search box reads "Search vendor" (singular); alt text: "Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line". PRD version 9 (23 Oct 2026), written after question 12, keeps "Search vendors" and adds that the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors (S5-R13); the singular "Search vendor" in the picture is not the requirement (Chris Ward's sheet row for question 12 repeats question 14's subject; PRD version 9 settles it). This case follows PRD version 9. The held design-version case D-77 (C715559) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
